sessions.phase_label: Website design, development, content integration, and final feature revisions

requirements.title: Instant Quote Calculator
requirements.definition: Interactive questionnaire that calculates a real-time estimated price using service selections, square-footage tiers, bundle eligibility, distance surcharges, and itemized prices.
requirements.boundary_note: Pricing tiers, bundle logic, service add-ons, distance surcharges, and the generated total are coupled parameters of one calculator mechanism; the later static pricing display and quote-submission form are separate Requirements.

requirements.title: Get a Quote Form Page
requirements.definition: Brand-matched Get a Quote page containing a custom form for Name, optional Company, Phone Number, Email, and Job Description, without Calendly.
requirements.boundary_note: The page, form fields, optional Company field, Calendly exclusion, and brand styling form one accepted page deliverable; routing the existing Book a Session control to this destination is independently testable.

requirements.title: Book a Session CTA Destination
requirements.definition: The Book a Session control must lead visitors to the selected quote or booking destination rather than remain without a defined destination.
requirements.boundary_note: This Requirement concerns navigation from the existing CTA; the contents and styling of the destination form page belong to REQ_GET_QUOTE_FORM_PAGE.

requirements.title: Package Pricing by Square Footage
requirements.definition: Display four packages or bundles with predefined prices that vary across four property square-footage categories.
requirements.boundary_note: Package count, square-footage categories, and rates are attributes of one pricing-matrix mechanism; calculator-driven pricing, itemized services, and mobile table behavior remain separate.

requirements.title: Itemized Service Pricing Transparency
requirements.definition: Present a complete and transparent breakdown of individual services, prices, and applicable square-footage categories so customers can understand and add individual items.
requirements.boundary_note: This Requirement covers the individual-service breakdown and detailed-pricing presentation, not package pricing calculations or the absence of recurring-pricing tabs.

requirements.title: One-Time Pricing Presentation
requirements.definition: Represent all offered pricing as one-time pricing and omit monthly and annual pricing tabs.
requirements.boundary_note: The one-time commercial model and removal of recurring-period controls are one display rule independent of package amounts and itemized-price completeness.

requirements.title: Mobile Pricing Table Layout
requirements.definition: Provide a usable mobile presentation for the multi-column pricing table, including the client-approved current horizontal-scrolling approach unless later changed.
requirements.boundary_note: Mobile table interaction can change independently of package values, itemized pricing content, and desktop presentation.

requirements.title: Gallery Browsing and Organization
requirements.definition: Provide a reliably browsable interactive gallery with scrolling and the requested organization of primary media categories and secondary photography.
requirements.boundary_note: Scrolling, category tabs, and reliable gallery display are parameters of the gallery browsing mechanism; hover effects and video support have independent trajectories.

requirements.title: Gallery Hover Effects
requirements.definition: Apply gallery-item hover animation behavior consistent with the selected desktop and mobile interaction policy.
requirements.boundary_note: Hover behavior can be retained, removed, or varied by device independently of gallery navigation, category organization, and content.

requirements.title: Gallery Video Integration
requirements.definition: Integrate video into the Gallery alongside portfolio imagery rather than limiting the gallery to still images.
requirements.boundary_note: Gallery video placement remained required when the homepage copy was removed, demonstrating an independent lifecycle from homepage video integration.

requirements.title: Homepage Video Integration
requirements.definition: Place portfolio video content near the homepage portfolio imagery when required.
requirements.boundary_note: Homepage video was independently added and later removed while gallery video remained, so the two placements must not be merged.

requirements.title: Image-Focused Site Design
requirements.definition: Keep the website highly visual and image-focused across its pages to reflect the photography business.
requirements.boundary_note: This is the sitewide visual-emphasis constraint; page-specific image mappings, selected assets, homepage overlay treatment, and animations are separately changeable.

requirements.title: Service-Specific Images
requirements.definition: Show a corresponding relevant image for each listed service, including photography, twilight, floor-plan, and 3D-view offerings.
requirements.boundary_note: The service-to-image correspondence is independently testable and is narrower than the general image-focused design or selection of concrete client-supplied assets.

requirements.title: Client Photo Asset Usage
requirements.definition: Use suitable client-supplied photography throughout the website, replace indicated stock imagery, and use a house photograph as the homepage image.
requirements.boundary_note: Asset selection and replacement form one content-placement mechanism, with the agency authorized to exercise judgment; service-specific image correspondence remains a separate acceptance rule.

requirements.title: Homepage Visual Design
requirements.definition: Follow the approved Option 2 homepage direction while emphasizing the hero image with a subtle low-opacity blue overlay.
requirements.boundary_note: Concept selection, image emphasis, overlay color, and overlay opacity are coupled attributes of the homepage visual treatment; media animation and link destinations are independent.

requirements.title: Homepage Gallery Animation
requirements.definition: Provide basic animation for the gallery or portfolio presentation shown on the homepage.
requirements.boundary_note: This homepage-specific animation is independently changeable from hover effects on Gallery-page items.

requirements.title: WordPress Hosting Environment
requirements.definition: Develop and deploy the website within the client-confirmed WordPress environment hosted through Namecheap and managed through cPanel.
requirements.boundary_note: This records the implementation-constraining platform and hosting environment, not credential exchange, delegated-access logistics, or administrative hand-off activity.

requirements.title: Homepage Section Button Links
requirements.definition: Ensure homepage controls and portfolio tiles navigate to their corresponding Gallery, Pricing, and Services destinations instead of returning users to the top of the homepage.
requirements.boundary_note: The destination routes are attributes of one homepage navigation mechanism; Book a Session routing is separated because it has its own destination decision and lifecycle.

requirements.title: Homepage Portfolio Tile Link
requirements.boundary_note: Changed by consistency audit.

requirements.title: Detailed Pricing Link
requirements.boundary_note: Changed by consistency audit.

unresolved_candidates.description: Booking functionality is said to be already under consideration, but the supplied evidence does not define its behavior well enough to establish an independent early booking Requirement beyond the later Get a Quote page and CTA destination.

The agency claims general desktop, tablet, and mobile responsiveness, but client evidence only establishes specific mobile pricing and hover decisions. It is unclear whether a separate sitewide responsiveness Requirement is warranted.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: One feature I have been considering is an instant quote calculator. Clients could complete a form or quiz that asks which services they want, and their answers would be used to calculate an estimated price in real time. It seems somewhat complicated from what I have researched, so is this something you would be able to build?

value_updates.output: estimated price calculated in real time

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Thanks so much for explaining. All of our services are itemized, and customers can qualify for a bundle as they select more services. The calculator would therefore need to recognize whether their selections meet the rules for a bundle; if they do not, it should simply add the individual service prices together. I picture it as a survey, potentially beginning like this:

Photos (yes/no)

value_updates.bundle_eligibility_behavior: determine whether selected services satisfy a bundle rule
value_updates.non_bundle_pricing_behavior: sum the selected individual service prices

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
Thank you for the clarification. Because all our services are itemized, selecting more of them can qualify a customer for a bundle. The calculator must determine whether the chosen services meet a bundle rule; otherwise, it should add the individual prices. I imagine a survey along these lines:

How many sqft is the property?
- under 1200: pricing tier 1
- 1201 - 2400: pricing tier 2
- 2401 - 3600: pricing tier 3
- 2401 - 3600: pricing tier 4
- 3601 +: pricing tier 5
(*An answer of 1840 sqft is assigned to pricing tier 2*)

Photos (yes/no): Yes = +320; No = +0.00 (*answers yes*)
Videos? (yes/no): Yes = +280; No = +0.00 (*answers yes*)
What is the address? The calculator determines the distance from the home office. If it is over 35 miles, apply a $90 surcharge. (*The submitted address is 42 miles away: +90*)
(*The selections qualify for the basic bundle: -$140*)
(*Presses submit*)
*Displays total: $550*

value_updates.square_footage_behavior: assign the entered property square footage to a pricing tier
value_updates.service_add_on_behavior: adjust the estimate according to yes-or-no service selections and their itemized prices
value_updates.address_behavior: use the submitted property address to determine distance from the home office
value_updates.bundle_discount_behavior: apply the qualifying bundle discount to the calculated price
value_updates.submission_output: display the calculated total after submission

source_message.speaker: agency
source_message.text:
Priya,

We’re already aware of the gallery glitch. Because the gallery still contains placeholder images and we’re waiting for your final images, we would prefer to replace those first and address the glitch afterward. Fixing it now could mean that the same issue returns when the images are swapped.

The mobile hover animations will also be removed, as we agree that hover effects are not ideal for touch screens.

For the pricing table, we recommend retaining horizontal scrolling on smaller screens. With several columns to display, this is the most practical way to keep every piece of information readable on mobile. Alternatively, the first column could remain fixed while all remaining columns scroll horizontally, as shown in the mobile implementation here: <https://vitalform-club.example/plans/>. Please tell us which option you prefer, or whether you have another approach in mind.

As requested, we’ll update the homepage buttons so they lead directly to the Gallery, Pricing, and Services pages.

We’ll begin the agreed changes and send you an update. The pricing-table work will remain pending until we hear which approach works best for you.

Thank you! 🙂
